short: The odd cohomology bound from Poitou–Tate duality

lean.name: UpperTheory.V.ML.iv
lean.plain: The odd cohomology bound from Poitou–Tate duality
lean.note: `ML.iv` takes Poitou–Tate duality and unramified orthogonality and concludes `PsiBound`. Unfolded, the bound applies to abelian CM fields with the indicated cyclotomic action and $\ell\ne2$, $\ell\nmid[E:\mathbb Q]$. The character must have sign $(-1)^{e+1}$ at complex conjugation.
